Here’s everything you need to know Zinc VC January 17, 2023 Venture Builder Zinc is seeking 50 extremely ambitious, talented individuals from across the globe who want to become Zinc Founders and build businesses to Improve the Health of People and the Planet. The 12-month Venture Builder starts full-time, in-person in our London headquarters, in October-November and April-May of each year. Will you rise to the challenge and join us? Zinc is an early-stage investor. We back Founders who want to build a new mission-driven business, even if they don’t yet have a team or an idea. We support the Founders to build brand new commercial businesses by providing access to co-Founders, investment, experts, in-house research & development (R&D) support and a proven process to launch a new venture. We’re excited to announce our investment in KiloGen , a Cambridge-based biotech developing a new platform for rational molecular glue discovery – unlocking one of the most promising and least solved frontiers in modern drug development. Led by experienced drug discovery leaders Mark McAlister PhD and Michał Biśta PhD , KiloGen is tackling a problem that has constrained medicine for decades: the vast majority of disease-driving proteins remain beyond the reach of conventional drugs. Their ambition is to make molecular glue discovery systematic , scalable , and repeatable . And in doing so, open up a new era of programmable pharmacology. Unlocking the “undruggable” majority Despite extraordinary progress in modern medicine, today’s small-molecule drugs can only target a fraction of human biology. CellMine, led by CEO Simon Rathbone and technical Director Adam Taylor , has developed a novel process for recycling lithium-ion batteries – commonly used in devices like smartphones, laptops, and electric vehicles – in an efficient, scalable and environmentally friendly way. CellMine’s mission is to prevent battery waste inundating landfills and to reduce industry’s reliance on mined metals. This funding round will enable the team to scale up their proven technology process for turning messy and varied waste battery feedstocks into clean chemical products ready to go back into the supply chain. This investment into Clyde, an innovative electrolyser startup spinning out of the University of Glasgow, will propel the team on its mission to revolutionise the hydrogen economy. So what is the hydrogen economy, and why are we so excited about this opportunity to partner with Clyde on this journey? Addressing the challenges of the evolving hydrogen economy Hydrogen is useful for all sorts of industrial applications and is vital for the climate transition, but its propensity to combust makes it difficult to produce, store and handle. This funding round will help propel founder Dr Dan Hardy and the team on their mission to harness Microsol’s powerful proprietary combination of advanced aerosol formulation development and computational pharmaceutics modelling, to enable more efficient and effective drug delivery for respiratory illnesses. Supercharging the search for your ideal co-founder | Zinc Our Mission Investment Portfolio Innovation Partners News Team Our Mission Investment Portfolio Innovation Partners News Team 3 MINS READ Supercharging the search for your ideal co-founder Eleanor Ford September 2, 2024 Entrepreneurship Leadership It is no secret that at Zinc we think Human Capital is the most important form of capital there is. We have written before about the fact that we know that the story of our impact starts with our people . How we find talent, how we develop it and how we support it is central to the change in our mission areas that we are here to create. But it is not just in the individuals we back, it is in the magic that goes into the forming and performing of founding teams. The Harvard Business Review reports that 65% of start-ups fail due to the breakdown of founder relationships, not due to market forces. Looking in the rear-view mirror across the individuals and ventures we have backed, that seems like a conservative number. That’s why we put time into supporting our Founders on their Co-Founder search from within and beyond our cohorts. The ability to attract and really understand the potential of candidates to found at Zinc is a core part of our offer. Tangent Secures $1.1M Pre-Seed Investment to Drive Social Mobility in Tech | Zinc Our Mission Investment Portfolio Innovation Partners News Team Our Mission Investment Portfolio Innovation Partners News Team 3 MINS READ Tangent Secures $1.1M Pre-Seed Investment to Drive Social Mobility in Tech Ella Goldner April 18, 2024 Employment Empowerment Entrepreneurship Impact Innovation Work We are excited to share Zinc’s investment in Tangent , a technology start-up on a mission to create a world where the social contexts you’re born into do not limit your career and wealth potential. Founders Gary Izunwa and Joe Adams met as part of Zinc’s fourth cohort, united by a passion to transform access to opportunities for jobseekers from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. This $1.1 million pre-seed funding round, including Google Black Founders Fund, Syndicate Room, a line-up of prominent angel investors as well as Scouts from Atomico and Ada Ventures, underscores Tangent’s commitment to addressing a huge, unaddressed diversity gap in the tech sector. Addressing the Diversity Disparity Recent data paints a stark picture: 9% of all UK tech employees come from low socioeconomic backgrounds despite making up 39% of the total UK population. This figure is significantly worse than the finance and law industries, where 29% and 23% of employees respectively come from low socioeconomic backgrounds.

Science-for-Impact entrepreneurs face a unique set of challenges, requiring specialist support and aligned funding. We know what it takes to succeed in the first two years. Team: Attracting and building a winning founding team including co-founders, early hires, advisors, and investment in the personal development of founders. Product: De-risking the science and technology and building a product that is validated through key inflection points. Commercial: Validating a commercial need from customers, building a commercial proposition to win large markets, and signing early customers and commercial partnerships. Capital: Securing funding to provide runway to build the science and the business from non-dilutive and dilutive funders and commercial revenue streams. Maria Fomina February 25, 2025 Aging Health Impact Innovation Jobs We are delighted to announce our third cohort of Innovation Fellowships in Health and Care at Zinc, which we will deliver in partnership with the NIHR and The Dunhill Medical Trust .
